verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform, so call forwarding is an applicable axis. However, the evidence never documents forwarding the business number to an external cell phone, conditionally or otherwise. The closest items are generic routing, ring orders, call transfers, phone menus, the Sona AI answering calls, and mobile apps. These are adjacent routing features or user-side workarounds, not the forwarding capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk
